items: ▶️ A paused player no longer hides another one that is playing.
🎵 Songs played in a video player aren't shown as "Watching" (Privacy > Show music too brings them back).
🔧 A full round of fixes: safer sign-ins, quicker cover retries, and a tray icon that always shows up.
🔎 The log names the file each title came from, and Copy diagnostics keeps titles and file names, so a wrong match can be traced.
🗂️ Sign-ins have their own Accounts tab; settings are grouped, texts are shorter, and the tray menu shows what the app is doing.
🔧 More reliable: Discord restarts no longer leave a plain status behind, and the settings and cover cache are saved safely.
🎞️ Jellyfin and Emby: sign in on the Advanced tab to show what you play on your own server, on any device.
🔗 The second line and the cover on Discord open the title's page (IMDb, AniList, ...), like the button.
🙈 Hide what I'm watching is now one click away in the tray (Windows) and the menu bar (macOS).
🍿 Stremio: sign in on the Advanced tab to show what you watch in Stremio, on any device.
💤 While Discord is closed, the app rests: it asks no player and hands its memory back.
🔔 New versions are looked for when the app starts too, and an open window shows one right away.
📰 What's new in an available update is laid out properly on the Updates tab.
📺 Anime episode titles come from MyAnimeList first, which numbers episodes the way your files do.
🎯 Long-running anime no longer show a neighbouring episode's title, or none at all.
🧭 A show that shares its name with a remake or a live-action series gets its own episode list.
🔁 An episode title that did not come is looked up again while the episode plays.
🎬 Plex: sign in on the Advanced tab to show what you watch on Plex, on any device.
📝 What's new: this list appears once after each update, and the Changelog button shows it any time.
📊 Your stats on the General tab: videos shown and time watched, kept on this computer only.
💬 Questions such as Quit now appear inside the window instead of a browser box.
💻 Runs on macOS (IINA, mpv, VLC, MPC-QT, in the menu bar) and on Linux (MPRIS players and mpv).
🚀 Start at login works on macOS and Linux too.
📺 Episode titles for anime matched on AniList.
🔎 Films whose file name lost a colon are found again.
🛠️ Update checks keep working past GitHub's hourly limit.
🎬 VLC support, with one-click setup of its web interface.
⚠️ The window says when VLC refuses the password or its port is taken.
🛠️ MPC-HC is no longer mistaken for MPC-QT.
🖼️ The cover now shows in the window's preview.
🔒 A web interface switched on by the setup button only answers this PC.
💤 "Discord on standby" while nothing plays.
🎬 MPC-QT and mpv support, and MPC-BE confirmed working.
🛠️ Quit no longer hangs when Discord stops responding.
⏸️ Your status clears after a 30-minute pause (changeable on the Privacy tab).
📋 Copy diagnostics for bug reports, with titles and paths left out.
🔍 A sharp tray icon on high-DPI screens.
🎬 MPC-BE support through its web interface.
🙈 Hide what I'm watching, and a Never show list for files.
🔔 An update notice next to the tray icon.
👋 A welcome card for new installs.
🔒 Privacy tab with a switch for each online service.
⏸️ Optionally clear your status after a long pause.
👀 A preview of how your status looks on Discord.
✅ Downloads you can verify (checksums and a signed build record).
🛠️ Edge no longer keeps running after the window closes.
🎉 First release: Discord Rich Presence for MPC-HC, with title cleanup and cover art.
